points.description: States that C++ programs begin execution at the main function, i.e. main() (equivalent wording such as 'the main() function' or 'int main()' accepted). Answers naming other places (e.g. constructors, first function defined, header files, first line of the file) do not earn marks.

levels.says: Vague or partly correct, e.g. says 'a function' or 'the start of the program' or 'the beginning of main code' without naming main.

rubric.notes: Full marks for naming the main function (main()). Part marks only for vague answers that don't name main. No marks for wrong locations such as header files or the first function written.
